It is imperative, for the sake of the nation's happiness in this world and the next, to rescue our sacred and divine beliefs and moral values from politics and all its aspects, which are dark and uncertain and a stage for all kinds of interests and passions to emerge. Only in this way will the greatness of Islam be revealed.

quotes.text: The outcome we have achieved today is the result of the vigilance born of centuries of national calamities and the blood shed in every corner of this sacred homeland. I entrust this outcome to the Turkish youth. O Turkish Youth! Your first duty is to preserve and defend Turkish independence and the Turkish Republic forever. ... You will find the strength you need in your noble blood!

quotes.text: The Grand National Assembly is the essence of the Turkish nation's centuries-long searches and the living symbol of its consciousness to govern itself. quotes.text: Our harmonious, rich language will reveal itself through the new Turkish alphabet. We must free ourselves from the incomprehensible and ununderstandable symbols that have confined our minds within an iron frame for centuries, and we must understand this necessity!

title: Antagande av lagen om antagande och genomförande av de nya turkiska bokstäverna. President Mustafa Kemals öppningstal för det andra mötsåret av den turkiska stornationalförsamlingens tredje period:
